sar.narrative: In the case of HHG-016, a suspicious $59.67 transaction was flagged after a customer reported it as unauthorized. The transaction occurred online from a new device associated with the customer's account, which the customer confirmed they had not used. This device profile, labeled as 'New,' has surfaced in connection with 30 different credit cards from other customers, several of which have confirmed fraud activity, suggesting a broader fraudulent operation. Furthermore, this particular device is linked to 20 previous fraud investigations, all involving similar patterns of unauthorized card-not-present transactions. The transaction deviated significantly from the customer's usual purchasing behavior, with no previous record of such activity from this device and only a single, isolated transaction appearing within a 48-hour period. These indicators suggest that the card details were likely compromised and used fraudulently in line with a common fraud pattern.
